connector.name: Mozaika
connector.registryDescription: Design references for coding agents: real product screens, sections and decoded design tokens.
connector.summary: Hosted at mozaika.design over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace design.mozaika, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Mozaika MCP token>, e.g. "Bearer mzk_...". Get your token at https://mozaika.design/connect
